content.text: Our ESG Policy — Sustainability is not an afterthought at Eden. It is embedded in every decision we make and every development we deliver.
Introduction — Eden is committed to delivering regeneration and residential development that creates long term environmental, social, and economic value.
Our ESG approach is embedded across the full development lifecycle — from site acquisition and design through to delivery and long-term operation.
We focus on unlocking underutilised assets, addressing housing need, and delivering sustainable, community-focused environments.
Environmental Responsibility — Commitments include sustainable regeneration, efficient design & construction, resource & waste management, and climate resilience.
Social Impact — Commitments include addressing housing need, community integration, local economic impact, employment & skills, and health & wellbeing.
Governance & Ethical Conduct — Commitments include responsible development, partnership & collaboration, compliance & risk management, and ethical business practices.
Delivery & Accountability — ESG commitments are integrated into Eden’s delivery model and decision-making processes, assessed against environmental, social, and viability outcomes.

Our Approach — ESG is fundamental to how Eden delivers. By aligning environmental responsibility, social value, and strong governance with a delivery-led model, Eden creates developments that are viable, sustainable, and impactful.
Operating Environments — Focus on South-East (senior living), Midlands (regeneration-led housing), and undersupplied markets aligned to local authority housing priorities.
Economic & Social Impact — Commitments include engaging local contractors, supporting regional supply chains, driving job creation, and promoting apprenticeship pathways.
Sustainable Development Approach — Reuse and regeneration of existing buildings, efficient design, alignment with sustainability priorities, and community integration.
